statement.zh: 「米诺斯海上霸权 / thalassocracy」作为解释模型有历史影响但受争议，不作定论。
statement.en: Minoan “thalassocracy” is a historically influential but contested interpretive model, not settled fact.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
